expect.en: Excuse me, where is the station?
Excuse me, may I get past?

de: Die Schülerin brachte eine Entschuldigung von ihren Eltern mit.
en: The pupil brought a note of excuse from her parents.

src: The noun card was glossed "sorry" and both its examples were the interjection — «Entschuldigung, wo ist der Bahnhof?» — which is the separate A1 phrase card `Entschuldigung`. The noun is the thing you offer or hand in.
